newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut oks NYNEX, Bell Atlantic merger.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut oks NYNEX, Bell Atlantic merger.

text.p: NYNEX Corp said on Wednesday the Connecticut Department of Public Utility Control voted unanimously to approve the merger between NYNEX and Bell Atlantic Corp.
The company said Connecticut is the first state in NYNEX's seven-state service territory to approve the merger.
"We're pleased by this ruling and look forward to approvals from other state commissions," said Ivan Seidenberg, NYNEX's chairman.
Reviews by all states are expected to be complete by early next year, the company said.
The proposed $22 billion merger between NYNEX and Bell Atlantic, announced in April, would serve 39 million telephone access lines in 13 states and more than 4 million cellular customers.
Shareowners of both companies approved the merger earlier this month.
